title: Second Largest
description: Write a function named second_largest that returns the second largest distinct number in a list. Return None when the list has fewer than two distinct values.
hints: Finding the second distinct largest requires filtering out duplicate occurrences of the maximum value.
Look at how you handle duplicates: sorting [5, 5, 5] yields 5 at index -2, but there is no distinct second value.
Converting the list to a set eliminates duplicates. Check if len(unique) < 2, returning None.
Filter unique = sorted(set(nums)). If len(unique) >= 2, return unique[-2], else return None.
